// Scanner cases for tests/temp-root-guard.test.ts, one per line; the test lists the lines that count.
await rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); // counted
await rm(file); // not counted: no recursion
rmSync(root, { // counted across lines
  force: true, recursive: true,
});
await fs.rm(join(a, ")"), { recursive: true }); // counted despite a bracket in a string
await rmdir(empty); // not counted
const dir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), "x-")); // counted
const sync = mkdtempSync(prefix); // counted
await Bun.$`rm -rf ${dir}`; // counted
Bun.spawn(["rm", "-r", dir]); // counted
mock.module("node:fs/promises", () => block(promises, ["rm", "rename"])); // not counted
import { mkdtemp, rm } from "node:fs/promises"; // not counted
import { rm as remove, rmSync as removeSync, mkdtemp as makeTemp, mkdtempSync as makeTempSync } from "node:fs";
await remove(dir, { recursive: true }); // counted through the alias
removeSync(dir, { force: true }); // not counted: no recursion
await makeTemp(prefix); // counted through the alias
makeTempSync(prefix); // counted through the alias
spawnSync("rm", ["-f", "-r", dir]); // counted
execFile("rm", ["--recursive", dir]); // counted
Bun.spawnSync(["rm", "-R", dir]); // counted
spawn("rm", ["-f", dir]); // not counted: no recursion
await Bun.$`rm -f -r ${dir}`; // counted
execSync(`rm --force --recursive ${dir}`); // counted
execSync(`find ${dir} -name '*.tmp' -delete`); // counted
Bun.spawn(["find", dir, "-type", "f", "-delete"]); // counted
Bun.spawn(["find", dir, "-type", "f"]); // not counted
rm(dir, options); // escapes: options held in a variable
fs["rm"](dir, { recursive: true }); // escapes: computed access
